posts.previewText: The AI Act deadline is still August 2026. The EU pushed the high-risk rules back to 2027 and 2028. Plenty of us read that as 'we can relax.' We read the wrong line. The Article 50 transparency obligations were never part of that delay. They still land on 2 August 2026...
